description: Fleet-wide Cove backup health, billing usage and storage trends, with local history.

novel_features.name: Storage growth / drift
novel_features.description: See which devices and customers are growing their backup storage fastest, from timestamped local snapshots.

novel_features.name: Fleet failure sweep
novel_features.description: Every device across all customers whose last backup session failed, aborted, errored, had no selection, never started or reported an unrecognised status, decoded to status names.

novel_features.name: Stale-device triage
novel_features.description: Devices with no successful backup in N days, ranked by staleness and grouped by customer.

novel_features.name: Status drift / what-changed
novel_features.description: Devices whose backup status flipped between the two latest snapshots of the same partner tree: regressions and recoveries without re-sweeping the fleet.

novel_features.name: Fleet health rollup
novel_features.description: One-screen rollup: total devices, healthy, failed, stale, never-run and unknown status, with a per-customer breakdown.

novel_features.name: Billing usage report
novel_features.description: Per-device SKU, used storage, and M365 seat counts with column codes decoded — the month-end billing export in one command.

novel_features.name: SKU change / billing delta
novel_features.description: Devices whose plan changed since last month — current SKU vs Cove's built-in previous-month SKU column.

novel_features.name: Data-source coverage
novel_features.description: Which data sources each device protects (Files, System State, SQL, Hyper-V, Microsoft 365), decoded fleet-wide, with a filter for devices missing one.

novel_features.name: Console activity digest
novel_features.description: Who did what in the Cove console: audit-trail actions grouped by user and operation across every sub-partner, with a breakdown by result.
